title: Storage layout
content:
# Storage layout

| Purpose | Drives | Layout |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Operating system | 2 × M.2 SSD | Hardware mirror (RAID 1) on the boot controller |
| Container data | 4 × 1.92 TB SSD | Presented individually, pooled by the OS as two mirrored pairs |

## Check what the server sees

```
racadm storage get controllers
racadm storage get vdisks
racadm storage get pdisks -o -p State
```

All physical disks should be **Online** or **Ready**, and the boot virtual disk should be **Online**.

## Replacing a data drive

1. Identify the failed drive with `racadm storage get pdisks` and the drive LEDs.
2. Replace it with the same model and size.
3. Add the new drive back to its mirror in the OS, and confirm the rebuild finishes.
4. Record the swap in the [[Maintenance log]].

Next: [[OS installation]].
